_comment: Release notes per versionName. Shown in the app's What's new popup (WhatsNew.kt) and used as the GitHub release notes by the githubRelease Gradle task. Newest version first. icon: favorite, share, navbar, chart, timer, weight, workout, calendar, home, settings, backup, update, bug, speed, star.

3.1.0.title: Stats and Sessions tabs
3.1.0.text: Workout Stats and Sessions have their own tabs and swipe pages. The navbar scrolls sideways and keeps the current tab in the middle.

3.1.0.title: Straight to your session
3.1.0.text: Saving a timer session takes you to Sessions, where you can see its heart rate graph or export it.

3.1.0.title: More timed exercises
3.1.0.text: Treadmill, Running, Walking, Cycling, Rowing, Yoga, Sauna and their Finnish names log as minutes. Side plank, Wall sit and Dead hang log as sets × hold time.

3.1.0.title: Contact support
3.1.0.text: Now opens a GitHub issue with your app and Android version filled in.

3.0.0.title: Heart rate
3.0.0.text: Connect a Bluetooth strap from the heart under the timer. Live BPM while you train, and every timed session saves its heart rate graph.

3.0.0.title: Export to Strava
3.0.0.text: Share icon in Sessions exports a .tcx file with time and heart rate. Upload it at strava.com/upload.

3.0.0.title: New navbar
3.0.0.text: Always visible, text labels only. While the timer runs, the Timer tab shows the time.

3.0.0.title: Weight chart
3.0.0.text: Pinch to zoom from 1 to 10 weeks, and a whole-kilo axis fitted to your weigh-ins.

3.0.0.title: Smaller app
3.0.0.text: The download is now about 4 MB instead of 19 MB.
